real_metalcytotox_v4.note: The two real references disagree by 40x on the three-ring share (0.49% vs 0.01%).  Both are near zero and both are three orders of magnitude below the generated pool, so the direction of the defect does not depend on which is used.

honest_limits: The checkpoint is a 20-epoch smoke arm, not the 18-epoch full-corpus run that produced the 66.8% c7 pool, whose checkpoint is no longer on disk.  This pool has 1.45 rings per molecule against the c7 pool's 6.31, so the prior has less to refuse here than it would on that pool; the direction is measured, the magnitude is not transferable.

The prior can only REMOVE closures.  A ring_6_share that stays below the gate is not evidence against the prior; it means the geometry did not offer hexagons to keep, which is the coordinate field's job (MOD2/MOD3) and the sampler's.

This checkpoint was trained WITHOUT the prior, so the comparison is prior-on vs prior-off at inference.  A model trained with the prior in its decode loop could adapt its bond logits to it; that is a different experiment.
